correctness.rationale: For M_(2n), n≥3, a maximal matching has exactly one nine-letter per-rung state (V,V) or (U/L/R,U/L/R)≠(U,U). Rail transitions (a_j=R)⇔(b_j=L), together with exclusion of adjacent U symbols, encode matched rail edges consistently and prevent adjacent unmatched vertices. The boundary flip is the rail-transposition matrix S, producing P_n(z)=tr(T(z)^n S). Splitting the commuting transfer T into symmetric and antisymmetric S eigenspaces gives Q_+=1−2zt−z²t³+z³t³−z³t⁴−z⁴t⁵ and Q_−=1+zt−z²t³. Formal log determinants yield the displayed generating series with terms n=1,2 removed. The substitution t=u/w²,z=w³ cancels zero-excess terms, proving 3|F|−2n>0. Exact w^1,w^2,w^3 coefficient calculations give minimum size floor(2n/3)+1 and all three residue-class multiplicity formulas, including n=3 six. I independently constructed ladder edges, exhaustively enumerated every maximal matching for n=3..8 and compared every cardinality coefficient against a separate exact polynomial log-derivative recurrence; e.g. P_4=16z³+7z⁴. Symbolic excess identities were separately checked. The infinite claim rests on the state bijection and formal identity, not finite extrapolation.

This is a meaningful graph-family invariant beyond ungraded counts and transfer-matrix methodology.
